words.name: lint-element-free-techniques
words.spec: Allow main and secret techniques in lint_techniques.py to declare names: [] when every ability across their layers has element == "" (element-free soul/seal/ward methods). Currently lint_techniques.py rejects names: [] unless slot == "body"; this forced temporary names: ["thuy"] proxies on Thu Phan's three element-free lineages, which causes CongPhap.usable() (src/gameplay/cultivation/cong_phap.gd:42-46) to return false for 5 living members lacking Water root (tham_tho_bich, tiet_an_suong, hua_tang_thu, thuong_dich_am, nhan_thu_mac). Once lint_techniques.py supports element-free main/secret techniques, restore names: [] on grave-sweeping-chant, autumn-grave-canon, and jade-of-resentment-ward.
words.gdd_text: Element-free soul/seal/ward methods open to any root (Thu Phan Pavilion: Grave-Sweeping Chant, Autumn Grave Canon, Jade of Resentment Ward).
words.decision_reason: Temporary names: ["thuy"] passes lint_techniques.py for Stage 6 staging but blocks 5 of 18 living Thu Phan members (Wood/Metal starts without Water) from passing CongPhap.usable() in Godot. s6-serial-b02 should teach lint_techniques.py to accept names: [] on element-free main/secret techniques and clear the temporary ["thuy"] proxy on all three Thu Phan techniques.
